# Retail CoD 1.1d dedicated server log lines under the --save-turret client of
# mp_carentan-dm-turret-hitbody.txt beside this file. Captured 2026-11-14.
# The -hitgrid recipe with probe_hitgrid 0, probe_spawnlog 1 and
# probe_bodylog 1: every hit's point and direction and the struck body's
# origin and angles, each to the float's last bit. The server ran under gdb
# with breakpoints on SV_LocationalTraceModel's entry (cod_lnxded 0x80c4564)
# and its return (0x80912f5) dumping the DObj's bone matrices, the body's
# frame, the local ray and the fraction (cod11-turrets.md 13.6). map
# mp_carentan, g_gametype probe_turret, probe_teleport 1, probe_hitlog 1,
# dedicated 1, sv_maxclients 8, sv_pure 0, a homepath holding no pak.
# Client 0 is a --probe-team axis --probe-fall net-probe standing as the
# target, client 1 the --save-turret gunner. All three inside one unshare -rn.
#
#   COD_DIR=<1.1 install> COD_LNXDED_HOME=<abs> PORT=28984 PROBE_SECS=230 \
#       tools/run_probe.sh client-probes/probe_turret mp_carentan +set probe_teleport 1 +set probe_hitlog 1 +set probe_hitgrid 0 +set probe_bodylog 1 +set probe_spawnlog 1
#   vcod --game-dir <1.1 install> --net-probe 127.0.0.1:28984 --probe-team axis --probe-fall --probe-secs 200   # 10 s in
#   vcod --game-dir <1.1 install> --net-probe 127.0.0.1:28984 --save-turret --capture-tag hitbody --probe-secs 190   # 5 s later
#
# PROBE hitfine <time> <num> <hitloc> <damage> <point> <dir> and
# PROBE hitbody <time> <num> <origin> <angles>, each component
# <int>:<thousandths>:<millionths of a thousandth> (probe_turret.gsc fine1).
# Lines are copied from games_mp.log, the m:ss stamp kept; every line past InitGame.
